$$\Rightarrow \left\{ \frac{(\frac{1-a}{1+a}-\lambda)(n-\frac{2a}{1+a}-\lambda)}{\frac{2}{1+a}\ln(1+\frac{1-a}{1+a}-\lambda)} \right\} = 0$$
